Subject: POC pricing ask + timeline (MedLytics)

Hi Neha and Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and routing features. We are moving this to an internal POC and have two asks up front: a 50% unit discount on hosted inference for the first 3 months of the POC, and help with a short SOW to ensure we can validate throughput under realistic load.

High level:
- POC duration: 90 days starting mid-March
- Expected token volume (month 1): ~120M tokens
- Goal: Validate 99th pct latency under 350ms and cost per 1k tokens target for production planning

Our procurement would need pricing confirmation by Feb 12 to hit our internal timelines. I attached the brief pricing worksheet and a draft SOW.

Can you confirm what level of discount is possible and any guardrails (commit, caps, trial credits)?

Thanks,

Vivek/Marcus — forwarding MedLytics' note. They want a 50% hosted inference discount for a 90-day POC (approx 120M tokens month 1). They pushed the procurement deadline to Feb 12.

Why I'm escalating:
- This is a high-signal health-tech prospect with clear paths to enterprise expansion and multiple units likely to convert to Dedicated capacity.
- Typical PO value if they convert: est. $420k ARR in year 1.
- The ask (50% on hosted) materially exceeds standard POC guidance (we usually offer credits up to $30k or 25% off for short trials).

Proposed exception:
- 40% unit discount for first 60 days, then revert to 25% discount for remaining 30 days; total committed minimum of $40k billed to cover baseline usage OR a capped credit of $60k (whichever yields lower downside).
- Conditional on: signed SOW + PO and HubSpot deal stage moved to "POC - Committed".

I have attached a simple margin calc and SOW redline. Would appreciate a quick read and sign-off so I can reply to Cara before the 12th.

Neha

Neha — thanks for the context. A couple quick items from ops/infra perspective:
- 120M tokens / month at POC scale is non-trivial but within our Hosted SLOs; however, we should require a burst cap and an explicit traffic pattern to avoid unexpected queueing.
- If we accept anything >35% discount, we'd need a deployment playbook and a guaranteed contact in their SRE team for load tests.

From commercial: I support a split approach but prefer the capped credit approach to avoid underpricing. Can Marcus confirm impact to margin if we do 40% for 60 days then 25% — assuming $0.06 per 1k token baseline? Marcus, can you run quick numbers and advise the minimum acceptable cap so we don't go below 30% gross margin on the POC?

Vivek
VP, Product Ops (acting), Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC pricing ask + timeline (MedLytics) -- requesting approval for exception

Quick math (rounded):
- Baseline list price: $0.06 / 1k tokens -> month1 list revenue @120M tokens = (120,000 * 0.06) = $7,200 (note: units mismatch fixed below)
- Correct calc: 120M tokens = 120,000 * 1k tokens; revenue at $0.06 per 1k = $7,200 (month) -> this seems low, please confirm pricing band.

Recomputing with our actual retail band: $6.00 per 1k tokens (retail for this workload class).
- Month 1 at 120M tokens: 120,000 * $6.00 = $720,000.
- 40% discount -> revenue = $432,000; gross margin (after cost-of-serving estimate) ~ 28% (below our 30% threshold).
- 25% discount -> revenue = $540,000; gross margin ~ 36%.

Recommendation: do NOT go to 40% for the full 60 days. Approve a blended proposal that achieves >=30% margin: 35% discount for first 30 days, 25% thereafter, plus a $60k capped credit tied to specific milestones (signed SOW + successful load test).

If that sounds good, Laura — can you approve the exception memo for 35%/25% blended with $60k cap and the contract language requiring PO and SRE contact? Neha, I'll prepare a short margin memo to attach to the approval note.

Marcus
Senior Director, Revenue Ops

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC pricing ask + timeline (MedLytics) -- approval memo

All — thank you for the clear analysis and urgency. I approve the exception with the following binding conditions:

1) Pricing: 35% unit discount for the first 30 days, then 25% discount for the remaining 60 days.
2) Cap: $60,000 maximum credit applied to invoices (as Marcus recommended).
3) Contract & Ops: Signed SOW and PO before discounting; MedLytics must provide an SRE contact and complete a jointly scheduled load test within the first 21 days.
4) Escrow/Close-out: If they convert to Dedicated within 9 months, apply a one-time conversion credit equal to any unused portion of the $60k cap (to be reconciled).

Neha — please send Cara an authorization memo and updated SOW reflecting these terms. Include Marcus' margin note and link to HubSpot deal MLX-47. Marking this closed from finance side.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance & Business Ops, Redwood Inference
